# Memory — backend scope

Index loaded at session start. One line per memory, no content here.

**Read first, every session:** `../../plans/from-health.md` (relative to the repo root) —
findings from the owner's real use of the product that imply a change here. It is written by the
health session and read by this one; it is the only channel between them.

**The health session owns** the owner's body, the daily log, and any fix provoked by his own use.
**This session owns** `backend/`. Do not edit files outside it.
